title: Editor crashes when shader material selected in the inspector and reloading scene
body:
### Tested versions

Bisect to dd9dc75a8331d9e86285b88e805e72c5f68231c3 #103708 (surprisingly).

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (dd9dc75a8) - EndeavourOS  SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 27 Jun 2025 16:35:07 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV RENOIR) - AMD Ryzen 7 4800U with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

I consistently experience crashes when switching and reloading scenes. See reproduction steps below for details.

The crash occurs when flushing the callable of `EditorNode::edit_item(Object*, Object*)` and calling `Object::cast_to`. Backtrace:
```
Object* Object::cast_to<Object>(Object*) (/home/luo/godot/core/object/object.h:803)
VariantObjectClassChecker<Object*>::check(Variant const&) (/home/luo/godot/core/variant/binder_common.h:241)
VariantCasterAndValidate<Object*>::cast(Variant const**, unsigned int, Callable::CallError&) (/home/luo/godot/core/variant/binder_common.h:267)
void call_with_variant_args_helper<EditorNode, Object*, Object*, 0ul, 1ul>(EditorNode*, void (EditorNode::*)(Object*, Object*), Variant const**, Callable::CallError&, IndexSequence<0ul, 1ul>) (/home/luo/godot/core/variant/binder_common.h:314)
void call_with_variant_args<EditorNode, Object*, Object*>(EditorNode*, void (EditorNode::*)(Object*, Object*), Variant const**, int, Callable::CallError&) (/home/luo/godot/core/variant/binder_common.h:428)
CallableCustomMethodPointer<EditorNode, void, Object*, Object*>::call(Variant const**, int, Variant&, Callable::CallError&) const (/home/luo/godot/core/object/callable_method_pointer.h:104)
Callable::callp(Variant const**, int, Variant&, Callable::CallError&) const (/home/luo/godot/core/variant/callable.cpp:57)
CallQueue::_call_function(Callable const&, Variant const*, int, bool) (/home/luo/godot/core/object/message_queue.cpp:220)
CallQueue::flush() (/home/luo/godot/core/object/message_queue.cpp:268)
SceneTree::physics_process(double) (/home/luo/godot/scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:534)
Main::iteration() (/home/luo/godot/main/main.cpp:4570)
OS_LinuxBSD::run() (/home/luo/godot/platform/linuxbsd/os_linuxbsd.cpp:980)
main (/home/luo/godot/platform/linuxbsd/godot_linuxbsd.cpp:85)
___lldb_unnamed_symbol3290 (@___lldb_unnamed_symbol3290:27)
__libc_start_main (@__libc_start_main:44)
_start (@_start:15)
```

### Steps to reproduce

Select the same material in the Inspector across two scenes simultaneously, **Reload Saved Scene**.

[crash-reload-material.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21141707/crash-reload-material.zip)
